caption: : Avg. rate at which the model attends most to each input segment: context, generated response, or other (e.g., system prompts) during generation.
model_annotation: The bar chart, titled "Avg. rate at which the model attends most to each input segment: context, generated response, or other (e.g., system prompts) during generation," compares the average attention distribution for two different input methods: "Ours" and "Standard." The horizontal axis represents the two methods, while the vertical axis indicates the percentage of attention. Each bar is segmented by color to represent the proportion of attention directed to three input segments: "Context" (blue), "Generated Response" (orange), and "Other" (green), as defined in the legend. For the "Ours" method, the model attends to the context 60.6% of the time, to the generated response 31.7% of the time, and to other elements 7.7% of the time. For the "Standard" method, the attention is distributed as 23.6% to the context, 51.1% to the generated response, and 25.3% to other elements. This shows that the "Ours" method results in significantly higher attention to the context and lower attention to the generated response compared to the "Standard" method, which shows a higher reliance on the generated response.
